dockerfiles.title: Production release image for GoReleaser
notes: This Dockerfile is used by GoReleaser to build release Docker images.
The binary is copied from the GoReleaser build context.

dockerfiles.title: Alpine-based production release image for GoReleaser
notes: Smaller image size using Alpine Linux.
The binary is copied from the GoReleaser build context (musl-linked).

dockerfiles.title: GPU-enabled production release image for GoReleaser
notes: This Dockerfile is used by GoReleaser to build GPU-enabled release Docker images.
The binary is copied from the GoReleaser build context.
Requires NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host system.

dockerfiles.title: FIPS-validated production release image (amd64 only)
notes: Multi-stage: copies validated OpenSSL FIPS provider from ci-catalog/zig-fips image.
MANUALLY MAINTAINED — do not run release_dockerfile_manifest.py sync on this file.
amd64-only: FIPS-validated OpenSSL provider is x86_64 Linux.
The geode binary must be built with -Dfips=true -Dopenssl_path=/usr/local/ssl.
